• Perform in-depth analysis of functional or business requirements

Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

jobs.description: Job Description: Company Description Alpine, an ITW company, is a leading provider of building component software, equipment, and the industry’s best service to component manufacturers. Experience with truss design and drafting techniques, including plating methods and/or light-gauge steel connection methods, engineering notes, design manuals, and span tables. Strong knowledge of structural engineering principles, applicable building codes and design standards, particularly statics and strength of materials. Ability to read and interpret roof and framing layouts and develop structurally sound, practical, and cost-effective truss configurations. Strong communication, documentation, customer-service, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
